title: 市场都预期50基点：他却说这是大错，美联储明年将被迫转向
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Central banks are tight in policy and the most overinflated part of assets is now selling off.
segments.zh: 央行政策收紧，资产中估值过高的部分正在被抛售。

segments.en: This is pretty standard, we see this time and time again.
segments.zh: 这很常见，我们一次又一次看到这种情况。

segments.en: I think central banks, at least where market's are priced, have much too much in the curve and I think that's starting to feed in.
segments.zh: 我认为，至少从市场定价来看，央行在利率曲线上的预期过多，现在开始产生影响。

segments.en: So I think that's one thing, you have this over assessment of what central banks need to do and breaking what are overvalued stocks.
segments.zh: 所以这是一点，市场对央行需要做什么的评估过高，导致估值过高的权益资产被打破。

segments.en: The second thing, which I think is probably more important, is the two sides of any technology trade, the innovation where markets put money towards the innovators and then eventually pivot to the companies that can use them, the diffusers.
segments.zh: 第二点可能更重要，任何科技交易都有两面：创新，市场把钱投向创新者，然后最终转向能够使用这些技术的公司，即扩散者。

segments.en: That's now ready to go and we've just had the last surge of innovators go to market just at the time when liquidity is drying up.
segments.zh: 现在时机已成熟，我们刚经历创新者的最后一波上市，恰逢流动性正在收紧。

segments.en: So I think what's going to happen is US markets are going to be in for a pretty painful ride.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，美国市场将经历一段相当痛苦的旅程。

segments.en: The Fed will be forced to scale back its rate hike expectations and then internet steel will start repositioning away from the US towards the companies that can actually use this stuff.
segments.zh: 美联储将被迫缩减加息预期，然后市场参与者将开始从美国重新配置到那些真正能使用这些技术的公司。

segments.en: So on the Fed you're not expecting 50 basis points in December.
segments.zh: 所以对于美联储，你不预期12月会加息50个基点？

segments.en: No, that would be a big mistake. That's way too much muscle memory from 2022.
segments.zh: 不，那将是个大错误。那是2022年留下的太多肌肉记忆。

segments.en: There's nothing in the fundamentals that just jest as anything like.
segments.zh: 基本面没有任何迹象表明会像那样。

segments.en: I think we'll get one more from the Fed and I think pretty early next year the Fed's going to realize this tight enough financial conditions in the US economy, which is coming from this stock market correction.
segments.zh: 我认为美联储还会再加息一次，而且明年初美联储就会意识到，美国经济的金融条件已经足够紧，这来自市场的调整。

segments.en: Right. We have a big impact on consumer pricing power. But I'll also count just by them talking about 50 basis points, that tights and financial conditions.
segments.zh: 对。这对消费者定价能力有很大影响。但我也算了一下，仅仅他们谈论50个基点，就会收紧金融条件。
